title: Full documentation sweep for expense-tracker (backend + frontend)

milestones.notes: Human-requested full doc sweep, not tied to a specific Plane ticket. Found drift: root README claimed 'no UI yet' though the frontend (EXP-17..EXP-22) had fully shipped, and frontend/README.md was still the unedited create-vite template. Fixed both READMEs and wrote docs/adr/0002-react-vite-frontend.md for the frontend addition (a real architectural decision not previously recorded). Ran audit-missing-docs afterward across both backend and frontend services — zero gaps found (README/ADR/API docs complete for both; runbook correctly not required since PROJECT.md has environments: []).

Follow-up gap caught by human review: root README's Getting Started section covered only the backend (uv sync / uvicorn) and never said how to run the frontend — the frontend was only reachable via a link from the Overview section. Added a 'Running the frontend' subsection to Getting Started (cd frontend, npm install, npm run dev, noting the dev-proxy dependency on the backend and Vite's default port 5173, confirmed absent from vite.config.ts so it is the tool default not an app-specific override).

Proactive re-check for the same failure mode (section present per template but substantively backend-only): 'Running tests' only covered pytest, and the Contributing checklist only listed backend lint/test commands. Added frontend cross-references (npx vitest run, npm run lint) to both.

next_step: None required now. Revisit the runbook requirement once PROJECT.md's environments list is populated with a real production environment.
